notes.title: Full game out NOW! 🥳 Win Steam Keys!
notes.content:
Hello fellow boomerang throwers!

Are you warmed-up? Because today is the day!

[b]The full version of Bamerang launches today, April 22nd, at 18:00 CEST[/b]. We're really excited to release this first game of ours and we hope you have as much fun playing it as we had developing it.

[previewyoutube=Ac07eLsjd68;full][/previewyoutube]

In the full game of Bamerang, you'll get..
[list]
[*] chaotic 2-4 player FFA or team games!
[*] over 20 map variations
[*] multi-round games, leading to celebrating winscreen
[*] more joyfull soundtracks by Lucien Montandon
[/list]

[h3]Win Steam keys for Bamerang[/h3]
To celebrate the launch, we're giving away Steam keys for Bamerang in the chat of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1236490/Bamerang/]broadcast on the store page[/url] for the first few hours after launch 🎉 So check out the broadcast if you're reading this on launch day!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1236490/Bamerang/

[h3]Let's get Bamerang to the front page[/h3]
If you like Bamerang and would like to support us, you can help us a lot by picking it up in the first few days and by writing a review. This way Bamerang will be visible for more people to enjoy. As a small Thank you, you can get Bamerang at a [b]15% discount in the first week[/b].

Drop by in our [url=https://discord.gg/x8sZEXy]Discord[/url] if you want to chat wiith us and other players.

Thank you all so much for your support so far! 🤗
What are you waiting for? Grab some friends and enjoy hilarious boomerang battles :D

-Lululu Entertainment

notes.title: Autumn Festival Demo with 4 Player-Mode & Dev Live Stream
notes.content:
[b]WOOOP, we're excited that Bämeräng is part of Steam's Autumn Edition of its Game Festival starting tomorrow, October 7th![/b] 

We added some exclusive content to the Autumn Festival Demo: 

[b]Unlocked 4 Player-Mode [/b]
For the very first time, you can fight intense four player battles!

[b]Loads of obstacles[/b]
Hide behind obstacles and discover how they change the dynamic of a match!


[b]Join our live stream tomorrow, on October 7th at 19:00 CEST[/b] 
We'll be battling through a heated Bämeräng tournament and answer all your questions!


Wishlist the full version of the game, which features over 20 different map variations:

[b]To download the demo, you have to visit the main page of Bämeräng with the link below.
Note: The demo will be available from October 7th - 13th. [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1236490/Bamerang/


Join our Discord to find people to play with and to give us your feedback:
https://discord.gg/x8sZEXy


Thank you for playing Bämeräng!
- Lululu
